pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "stark" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. small
   B. hard-working
   C. old
   D. strong

2. What is the plural of "der Stuhl"? (1 mark)
   A. die Stuhls
   B. die Stuhle
   C. die Stühle
   D. die Stuhler

3. Which body part do we link with "hören"? (1 mark)
   A. die Hand
   B. das Ohr
   C. die Nase
   D. das Auge

4. What does "der Freund" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. friend
   B. brother
   C. brothers and sisters
   D. grandfather

5. What does "der Apfel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. banana
   B. potato
   C. apple
   D. fish

6. What does "der Donnerstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Thursday
   C. Monday
   D. weekend

7. What does "wolkig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cloudy
   B. cold
   C. wet
   D. foggy

8. Which completes "Das Bild hängt an ___ Wand"? (1 mark)
   A. dem
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

9. What does "groß" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. old
   B. kind
   C. tall or big
   D. hard-working

10. What does "neben" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. on
   B. next to
   C. under
   D. in front of

11. Which German word or phrase means "please"? (1 mark)
   A. Hallo
   B. Bitte
   C. Bis morgen
   D. Guten Tag

12. Which word in the menu joins two foods? (1 mark)
   A. aber
   B. oder
   C. nicht
   D. und

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Regenbogen"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. den
   D. der

14. What does "nass" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. wet
   B. hot
   C. foggy
   D. cold

15. What does "Nein, danke" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yes, please
   B. Good night
   C. No, thank you
   D. See you soon

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Complete with the correct verb form: "Mutter ___ (kochen). Vater ___ (lesen). Der Hund ___ (schlafen)." (3 marks)

17. Write two sentences about healthy food and one about unhealthy food in German. (3 marks)

18. Write the German words with der, die or das for: plate, lamp, tomato, knee. (4 marks)

19. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear. (3 marks)

20. Unscramble and write with der or die: STWECHERS. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — strong
   stark means strong.

2. C — die Stühle
   The plural of der Stuhl is die Stühle.

3. B — das Ohr
   We hear with the ears.

4. A — friend
   der Freund means friend.

5. C — apple
   der Apfel means apple.

6. B — Thursday
   der Donnerstag means Thursday.

7. A — cloudy
   wolkig means cloudy.

8. C — der
   Wand is a die word, so an der Wand.

9. C — tall or big
   groß means tall or big.

10. B — next to
   neben means next to.

11. B — Bitte
   please in German is Bitte.

12. D — und
   und means and.

13. D — der
   It is der Regenbogen, so the little word is der.

14. A — wet
   nass means wet.

15. C — No, thank you
   nein = no and danke = thank you.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: kocht, liest, schläft.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb form.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Obst ist gesund. Wasser ist gesund. Limonade ist ungesund.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Teller, die Lampe, die Tomate, das Knie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the article.
